'''Dargulli''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kether system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
{{Quote|Vader! Darth Vader! He's alone! We got a bunch of freelancers trying to take him down!|A bounty hunter|<ref name="Empire 4">[[Empire 4|''Empire'' 4]]</ref>}}
[[File:SWEMP3-FC.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] fighting on Dargulli.]]

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was lured to Dargulli by rumors of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] operating on the planet. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was on the planet at that time, and was able to help Vader when he was [[Ambush on Dargulli|ambushed]] by local bounty hunters bent on making a name for themselves. With the aid of Fett, Vader eliminated all of his attackers, only to be approached by a [[Dargulli Dark Jedi|Human woman]] with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. She tried to convince [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to take her on as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] but Vader killed her instead.<ref name="Betrayal" />
